During the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the '''Haik Expedition''' was an expedition consisting of explorers who sought to find shorter routes through known space. Specifically, they sought to find a route between the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]] and the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]]. During the expedition, they discovered the [[Kira system/Legends|Kira system]], and used the newly discovered system as a reference and namesake for the [[Kira Run]].
